message.content: During the conversation, LiHua mentions multiple memorable matches involving FC Barcelona. She expresses that her favorite match is the 2009 Champions League final against Manchester United, where Carles Puyol lifted the trophy and Lionel Messi scored a remarkable goal. LiHua also recalls fondly another El Clásico match against Real Madrid in 2013 where Barcelona turned things around, showing their resilience and dominance. However, her absolute favorite match appears to be the 2009 Champions League final.
